settings.label: Server name
settings.description: Name players see in the in-game server browser. Docker images often overwrite it from an environment variable at start.

settings.label: Save folder
settings.description: Folder for the world saves, relative to the server folder or absolute. Since version 1.0 it also holds backup subfolders.

settings.label: Log folder
settings.description: Folder the server writes its log file to. A relative path starts from the working folder of the server.

settings.label: Browser tags
settings.description: Labels for the server browser filter, taken from the game's fixed list; any other word stops the server at start.

settings.label: Bind address
settings.description: IPv4 address the server listens on. Keep 0.0.0.0 inside containers unless one specific interface is needed.

settings.label: Query port
settings.description: UDP port for Steam queries and for joining. Open it in the firewall and keep it in step with any container port mapping.

settings.label: Player slots
settings.description: Most players allowed online at once. The game caps it at sixteen, and seats reserved for roles come out of this total.

settings.label: Voice chat range
settings.description: Whether a voice is heard only near the speaker or by everyone on the server. The value is case-sensitive.

settings.label: Voice chat
settings.description: Turns the built-in voice chat on or off for the whole server. While it is off, the voice range does nothing.

settings.label: Text chat
settings.description: Turns the in-game text chat window on or off for every player who joins this server.

settings.label: Difficulty preset
settings.description: Picks a built-in difficulty profile. The custom difficulty values below take effect only when this is set to Custom.

settings.label: Player health
settings.description: Multiplies the maximum health of every character. The game shows it as a percentage, where 1 is the normal amount.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Player mana
settings.description: Multiplies maximum mana, so higher values allow more spells before players must wait for mana to return.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Player stamina
settings.description: Multiplies the stamina pool used for sprinting, dodging, climbing and weapon swings.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Body heat
settings.description: Scales the body heat reserve. Higher values let players stay longer in freezing areas before the cold starts to hurt.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Diving time
settings.description: Scales the starting air supply, which decides how long a character can stay underwater before drowning.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Weapon durability
settings.description: When on, weapons wear down with use and need repair. Turn it off so gear never wears out.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Hunger and starving
settings.description: Turns on hunger. Players who go too long without food or drink start starving and lose health until they eat.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Food bonus duration
settings.description: Multiplies how long the bonuses from eating and drinking last before players need another meal.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Hungry to starving time
settings.description: Time from becoming hungry to starving, stored in nanoseconds: 5 to 20 minutes, 10 by default. Only used while hunger is on.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Time in the Shroud
settings.description: Scales the time a player can spend in the Shroud before its harm begins. Values above 1 extend that grace period; below 1 the fog hurts sooner.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Items lost on death
settings.description: What a dead player leaves in a grave to recover later: only materials, every item, or no grave and nothing lost.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Curse chance
settings.description: Sets how often enemy hits apply a curse. Normal keeps the usual odds, Hard makes curses more frequent, and the Easy step removes curses from the game entirely.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Day length
settings.description: Length of daylight in nanoseconds, from 2 to 60 minutes. The default is 30 minutes of day.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Night length
settings.description: Length of the night in nanoseconds, from 2 to 60 minutes. The default is 12 minutes of night.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Weather events
settings.description: How often weather events such as storms show up in the world. Disabled turns them off.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Glider turbulence
settings.description: When on, air turbulence pushes gliders around. Off gives the calm gliding of older game versions.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Startled while taming
settings.description: How much taming progress is lost when a player scares the animal being tamed.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Fishing difficulty
settings.description: How hard the fish fight on the line. Every step up makes the catch struggle longer before it gives in; the easiest steps suit new anglers.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Flame level for Shroud altars
settings.description: Sets which Flame Level a player must reach before altars may go up inside the Shroud. A higher number keeps that locked behind more progress.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Mining damage
settings.description: Multiplies mining damage. Higher values dig away more terrain and give more resources with each hit.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Plant growth speed
settings.description: Multiplies how fast crops and other planted seeds grow before they can be harvested.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Loot stack size
settings.description: Multiplies how many materials each loot stack holds, whether it comes from a chest or a defeated enemy.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Workshop speed
settings.description: Multiplies how fast crafting stations produce items. Higher values mean shorter crafting times.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Combat experience
settings.description: Multiplies the experience points players earn by defeating enemies.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Mining experience
settings.description: Multiplies experience from mining. Zero is allowed and means mining gives no experience at all.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Exploration and quest experience
settings.description: Multiplies the experience earned by discovering places and finishing quests.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Weapon upgrade cost
settings.description: Multiplies how many Runes each weapon upgrade costs. Lower values make upgrades cheaper.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Runes back from salvage
settings.description: Portion of the Runes a player gets back after scrapping an upgraded weapon. The default, 0.5, refunds half; 1 refunds every Rune.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Enemy numbers
settings.description: How many enemies populate the world. Automatic adjusts the number to the size of the group nearby.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Enemies attacking at once
settings.description: Cap on how many enemies may attack one group at the same time. It is a step on a scale, not a percentage.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Enemy damage
settings.description: Multiplies the damage regular enemies deal. Bosses use their own damage setting.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Enemy health
settings.description: Multiplies the hit points of regular enemies. Bosses are scaled by their own health setting.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Enemy stamina
settings.description: Multiplies regular enemy stamina; higher values make enemies harder to stun. Bosses are not affected.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Enemy perception range
settings.description: Scales the senses of regular enemies. Above 1 they notice players sooner and from farther away; below 1 they must come closer first. Bosses ignore this one.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Boss damage
settings.description: Multiplies the damage of boss attacks. Its lowest value, 0.2, sits a little below the one for regular enemies.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Boss health
settings.description: Multiplies boss hit points, which makes boss fights shorter or longer.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Enemy aggression
settings.description: Multiplies how often regular enemies start an attack. Higher values give fiercer fights; bosses are not affected.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Passive enemies
settings.description: When on, regular enemies stay passive until a player hits them first. Bosses still attack.
settings.overrideNote: Used only while the difficulty preset is Custom; with any other preset the game applies its own built-in values.

settings.label: Role 1 name
settings.description: Name of the first role in the file. A file the game writes lists Admin here; roles are told apart by name, so each must be unique.

settings.label: Role 1 password
settings.description: Password that gives a joining player the first role in the file (Admin in a file the game writes). The game makes a random one at first start. An empty password leaves the role open to every joiner.

settings.label: Role 1 reserved seats
settings.description: Player seats held free for the first role. Reserved seats of all roles together must fit within the player slots.

settings.label: Role 2 name
settings.description: Name of the second role, when the file holds that many. Roles are told apart by name, so every name must be unique.

settings.label: Role 2 password
settings.description: Password that gives a joining player the second role in the file (Friend in a file the game writes). The game makes a random one at first start. An empty password leaves the role open to every joiner.

settings.label: Role 2 reserved seats
settings.description: Player seats held free for the second role. Reserved seats of all roles together must fit within the player slots.

settings.label: Role 3 name
settings.description: Name of the third role, when the file holds that many. Roles are told apart by name, so every name must be unique.

settings.label: Role 3 password
settings.description: Password that gives a joining player the third role in the file (Guest in a file the game writes). The game makes a random one at first start. An empty password leaves the role open to every joiner.

settings.label: Role 3 reserved seats
settings.description: Player seats held free for the third role. Reserved seats of all roles together must fit within the player slots.

settings.label: Role 4 name
settings.description: Name of the fourth role, when the file holds that many. Roles are told apart by name, so every name must be unique.

settings.label: Role 4 password
settings.description: Password that gives a joining player the fourth role in the file (Visitor in a file the game writes). The game makes a random one at first start. An empty password leaves the role open to every joiner.

settings.label: Role 4 reserved seats
settings.description: Player seats held free for the fourth role. Reserved seats of all roles together must fit within the player slots.

rules.message: Custom difficulty values were changed, but the game uses them only when the difficulty preset is Custom. Switch the preset to Custom or these changes have no effect.
A role has an empty password, so anyone could join with that role.
Two roles have the same name. The game tells roles apart by name, so each name must be unique.
The seats reserved for roles add up to more than the player slots, so some roles could never get the seats held for them.
A voice chat range is chosen but voice chat is off, so the range does nothing until voice chat is turned on.
The hungry to starving time is changed, but hunger is off, so the value has no effect.

presets.label: Default
presets.description: Switches to the game's Default difficulty preset and puts every custom difficulty value back to what the game starts with.

presets.label: Relaxed friends
presets.description: A Custom difficulty for small friendly groups: tougher players, softer enemies, no lost items and quicker crafting.

presets.label: Hard survival
presets.description: A Custom difficulty with hunger on, fiercer enemies, every item lost on death and longer nights.
